name: graph_from_blank
description: GL-1d: a render pass built in the Graph from nothing. From a Blank project, the Graph tab's Add opens the palette; the filter narrows it to render.material_pass, the contract combo picks deferred_geometry_v1, and Enter adds it. The pass arrives drawing: in the same list, its images, a draw_loop render_material_pass_draws over its draw items and that loop's body render_material_pass_draw, whose one step is draw.material, feeding the pass's draws -- the shape decompose_material_pass writes. After the engine takes it (restarting if it asks to, RS-1), the root canvas draws the pass beside the loop's zone with draw.material inside it, the frame plan runs the loop as a draw_loop, and the Frame Plan tab lists the pass.
